title: Hazel librarian review
description: The outcome of the librarian gate for one delta. Records what was accepted, rejected and amended, and why. This is the audit trail of the gate itself: without it the ledger shows what was approved but not what was declined, and a reviewer cannot tell a considered rejection from an oversight.

delta_sha256.description: Hash of the delta as reviewed. Binds this review to exactly what was on screen; re-extracting invalidates it.

outcomes.description: One entry per candidate in the delta. Every candidate must be accounted for — no silent drops.

outcome.description: accepted_amended means the librarian changed the statement, owner or routing before promoting. deferred means it stays a candidate for a later review.

record_id.description: The id issued on acceptance. Required for accepted and accepted_amended.

reason.description: Required for rejected and deferred. Why this is not becoming a record.

amendments.description: Required for accepted_amended. What the librarian changed and why.

not_promoted_reviewed.description: The librarian confirms they read the extractor's not_promoted list. False means the gate was only half applied — what the extractor discarded went unexamined.

promoted_from_not_promoted.description: Items the extractor declined to propose that the librarian promoted anyway. These are the extractor's misses and are worth reviewing periodically to tune the rubric.

note.description: Optional overall remark on this review.
